LABOPS 2026 ANNUAL OPERATIONS AND FINANCIAL CLOSURE REPORT V1.0

1. Executive summary

During 2026, LabOps coordinated travel, purchasing, recruitment, visitors, training, inventory, infrastructure, administrative filing, and support for NEXUS project closure. This report consolidates activity, budget, incidents, controls, pending items, and priorities for 2027.

The managed budget was EUR 286,400. At closure, EUR 278,920 had been committed and EUR 271,680 paid. The difference relates to three invoices awaiting compliant receipt, one contractual retention, and two trips whose expense reports were received after the cut-off.

The Atlas-2 expansion was the main infrastructure investment. Funding also covered storage, technical licences, mobility, translation services, maintenance, training, and temporary engineering support.

2. Scope

The report covers the LabOps initiative and administrative operations for SILEX, LUMEN, VERDANT, ARIADNA, and ORION. It does not replace the official accounting of Sierra Centro Public University. Amounts are compared with institutional records, and differences are explained.

3. Governance

Clara Ibáñez Soto coordinated budget and purchases. Rosa Mena Ortiz managed travel, visitors, cases, and filing. Nuria Castaño Rey coordinated infrastructure and inventory. Project leads validated need, funding, and receipt.

Operations separate request, review, approval, execution, and closure. Exceptions have a reason, owner, and date. An activity is not marked closed where invoices, access, advances, or deliverables remain open.

4. Overall status

Thirty-seven trips, twenty-four purchases, three recruitment processes, seven visits, five training activities, and eighteen inventory movements were processed. Ninety-two percent of cases closed before 15 December. Remaining cases have recorded actions and dates.
